ui.guidance.topic-economy-body:
Builders construct structures. Select a builder, choose a recipe and place a valid site. Construction pays when the site is created; cancelling unfinished construction refunds its cost. More builders can assist.
Supply Trucks mine ore, carry it to a friendly dock and unload credits. Resource Extractors occupy discovered material or oil nodes: materials support production, while oil earns credits. Remote extractors do not extend your build radius.
Completed power structures supply capacity; consumers use it. Brownout slows production and extraction. Switch off an unneeded consumer or build more supply. Read each installed structure's statistics and costs in the roster.
ui.guidance.topic-fog-body:
Units and structures reveal terrain within their sight range. Cliffs and opaque props can block sight. Move scouts to discover resource nodes and enemy positions.
The minimap distinguishes unexplored, explored and currently visible terrain. A remembered enemy structure marks its last known position; it does not prove that the structure is still there. Hidden enemies do not provide live health, orders or production information.
Click the minimap to move the camera. Right-click it to issue a destination to selected actors. Use attack-move when you want eligible combat units to engage enemies on the route.
ui.guidance.topic-combat-body:
Select combat units, then use attack for a target or attack-move for a destination. Stop clears current orders; hold position keeps units from pursuing. Hover a command to read its currently assigned shortcut.
Weapons have target restrictions, range, reload time and warhead effects. Ground targeting includes structures. Armour multipliers in each weapon table describe authored damage modifiers, not guaranteed final damage or universal counter rankings. Explicit zero means that damage component does not affect that armour.
Keep scouts and support with your army, watch health and retreat when needed. The first local skirmish ends when a Force has no surviving units or structures. Surrender ends your match immediately.
